name: Ailbhe Faye
source:
Member of the Faye security team, formerly of the SOU.

She's a Patach, but seems unusually attached to [url=https://vndb.org/c146901]Cerys[/url]. She practically glared me into needing [url=https://vndb.org/c146900]Áine[/url]'s healing again after discerning that Cerys 'used violence against me'. She assumed I tried to hurt Cer and had to be called off by [url=https://vndb.org/c170467]Eithne[/url].

[In game description]
